                    Clerk’s Office – DMV Update        
2025 BOAT REGISTRATIONS- EFFECTIVE 1/1/2025 
House Bill 1304 has become law for the 2025 boating season. This law change modifies the procedure for registration of vessels by requiring the issuance and display of a boat fee decal for the payment of boat fees. You will notice that the fee will be increased by $3.00, and you will now receive two sets of decals that must be displayed on each side of the bow. 
                    Property Tax Bills and Payments        
Property Tax Bills are issued twice yearly: 
First issue tax bills, usually due July 1 st  are based on one-half of the prior year’s tax bill (check bill for actual due date) 
Second issue tax bills, due in December are based on the new tax rate 
To see the history of how the tax rate has been calculated and applied between the Municipal, County, School, and State Edcuation tax see the  2025 Tax Rate History  document  (Documents) 
More information about revaluations, assessments, tax rates, exemptions, credits, abatements, tax cards, tax maps and more can be found on our  Assessing Department  web page. 
Tax Bills are now available for viewing online!  The file is in .pdf format. Once you have opened the file hit CTRL F and a “Find” box will open. Type in the full tax map & lot number (000-000-000-000) or the last name of the lot owner to access a particular tax bill.  The file is large and may take several minutes to download.  Available tax bills are listed under  Documents.
